feature: An agent cuts a video from History clips
summary: An agent (Claude Code with the Photonz server) can now make a video from your History recordings in the Photonz you have open: clips in order, title pages in the app's styles with its words, transitions at the cuts, the zooms Photonz recommends, and an MP4. Each step is one Command Z.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Run Scripts/install-mcp.sh once, then start a fresh `claude` session in any folder. The montage scenario's three runs and the full transcript of the last one are in 2026-10-19-agent-video-transcript.md.

try.do: In a fresh claude session, say: I made 5 clips in my history. Take the last 5, and create a video montage which has a title page, and subtitle pages per clip with nice consistent layout and transitions. I want to see clips with recommended zooms. Each subtitle should show Case N where n is the clip number (1 through 5).
try.shotNote: A frame of the exported MP4 at 0:02.5, drawn by Photonz from the file, not a capture of the window.

try.do: Watch a new window open with the five recordings laid end to end on V1, then the pages appear in front of each one.
try.shotNote: The first 30 seconds of the exported file: the opening page, Case 1, its zoomed recording, Case 2, Case 3.

try.do: Press Command Z once after any single step the agent took (a page, a transition, the zooms) and see exactly that step come off.
Scrub across a cut between a recording and the next Case page: it dissolves.
try.shotNote: The last 22 seconds of the exported file: Case 4, Case 5 and the zooms on their recordings.

try.do: Open the MP4 the agent wrote (the 480p copy is 2026-10-19-agent-video-montage.mp4) and play it through.
Ask the agent to make Case 3 shorter and export again; it trims with ripple so the pages after it move up.

evaluate: Does the montage read as one consistent piece: the same page style for every case, the same dissolve at every cut?
Is putting a page in front of each clip, with everything after it moving along, what you expected the agent to do?
When the agent leaves a style's second line out, should the page lose that line (as now) or keep a line of the agent's choosing?
Is the agent's choice of the newest five recordings, oldest first as Case 1, the order you meant by the last 5?
rough: No mock covers the agent tools: they have no surface of their own, and every step lands in the editor exactly as the menu row it maps onto does.
No window capture: the pictures are frames of the exported MP4 drawn by Photonz's own decoder (video_frame on the opened file), because what the agent made is the film.
The Keynote Clean background draws hard rectangles around its glows (visible in every page here). Filed as the-keynote-clean-title-page-draws-its-starfield.

Inserting a page puts the default transition only on the join from the page into its clip; the cut from the clip before into the page stays a hard cut until the agent sets one (it did, with set_transition). That is the person's Insert Title Page rule.
A new video given a length shrinks to its title when the title is all that is on it (a 6 second video became 4). Filed as find-out-whether-a-new-video-should-keep-the-len.
The full-size MP4 was 366 MB at 3456 by 2234; the copy here is the agent's 480p export re-encoded with ffmpeg to 6.4 MB.
